scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && PORT=26224 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/procurement-workspace run build && PORT=8081 BASE_PATH=/__mockup pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run build && pnpm --filter '!@workspace/procurement-workspace' --filter '!@workspace/mockup-sandbox' -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
